title: Rapidinha
summary: Web system for pre-orders and organized pickup at school canteens, with stock control. React, Vite, TypeScript and Supabase with Row Level Security.
features: Responsive interface for students and canteen staff
Object-oriented modeling with a list, a FIFO queue and a stack
Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL with per-profile Row Level Security
Tests with Vitest, Testing Library and Playwright
